meta.conventions: H = lock-in transfer of Delta = DNa02_R - DNa02_L (Hz) re yaw rate r (deg/s); gain Hz per deg/s; phase deg of Delta re r; seed-averaged H = mean(H_re) + j mean(H_im)

a.rule: real seed-mean coherence > 0.5 at every f <= 2 Hz

b.rule: cos(phase of seed-averaged H) < 0 at every f <= 1 Hz

coherence.statistic: mean over seeds of per-seed coherence at 1.0 Hz

gain.statistic: mean over seeds of per-seed gain at 1.0 Hz

H1_secondary_type_null.label: SECONDARY (not the pre-registered H1 null): type-preserving null

identified_sign_note: identified_sign is the pre-registered rule and is applied regardless of coherence; a sign is only meaningful where 1 Hz coherence is well above the noise floor

G1.rule: real seed-mean coherence < 0.3 at every frequency -> G1 fails, try the pre-listed alternatives

coherence_null.method: stats.null_coherence: sine vs white noise, nperseg = 1 cycle, cycles as run (run_phase1.n_cycles)

amp.label: exploratory
amp.note: gain = seed mean of per-seed lock-in |H| (the H1 statistic); it is biased upward by noise when coherence is low
